title: Affine tilde comparison for one positive homogeneous graded-module chart
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, and $M$ a $\mathbb Z$-graded $S$-module with internal grading $\mathcal M$ compatible with scalar multiplication. Set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$, put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], and let $Z_f$ be submodules of $M_a$ whose carriers are precisely the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions]. Suppose additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ and ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ are given for every $D_g\subseteq D_f$. Suppose each inclusion admits a homogeneous relation $g^e=bf$ with $e>0$, each $\rho$ is semilinear over $\rho^S$, and for every such relation it sends $y/f^m$ to $b^my/g^{em}$. Assume identities, composition and bijectivity when chart opens coincide. Assume moreover every ring restriction is induced by a ring map $S_f\to S_g$ commuting with $S$. Let $F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules with additive identifications $F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, scalar compatible via awayToSection and restriction compatible with $\rho$. Then, for each positive homogeneous chart $f$, the restriction $F|_{D_f}$ is isomorphic as an $\mathcal O_{D_f}$-module to the restriction of $\widetilde{Z_f}$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] along the canonical isomorphism $D_f\cong\operatorname{Spec} R_f$ [lem-weil-pbc-proj-basic-open-intersection]. The conclusion is an affine chart comparison, not an assertion of global quasi-coherence.

proof.text: Fix f of degree d>0 and represent r in S_(f) by a/f^n with a homogeneous of degree n*d. Set h=f*a, of positive degree (n+1)*d. The chart preimage formula identifies D_+(h) with D(r^d)=D(r). Localization at r^d equals localization at r since d>0; the inverse to r is r^(d-1)/r^d. These opens realize every principal open on Spec S_(f), including the empty open when r=0.

Apply gradedModuleAwayRestriction. Identify its submodules with Z using the carrier equalities hZ. For D_+(g) contained in D_+(f), the given and constructed restrictions agree: choose the homogeneous relation g^e=b*f from hlaws and represent an arbitrary section by y/f^m. Both restrictions send it to b^m*y/g^(e*m), by their stated fraction formulas, and the target submodule inclusion is injective. For ring maps, hcanonical and uniqueness of maps out of S_f identify the ambient maps and injectivity of S_(g) into S_g identifies the degree-zero maps. Thus theta induces the canonical localization comparison for the specified Z and rho.

Compose alpha with these localization comparisons and the tilde.toOpen identifications of principal-open sections. Scalar compatibility follows from hscalar and the agreement of the ring maps. Restriction compatibility follows from hrestriction and the comparison composition law: on a nested principal localization the two maps agree on Z_f, and localization uniqueness makes them equal everywhere. The ring chart is basicOpenIsoSpec, so these are linear equivalences for the actual structure sheaf.

Extend the compatible linear equivalences and their inverses off the principal-open basis by the basis-extension universal property. Their composites restrict to identities on each basis open, hence are identities by uniqueness. Transport along basicOpenIsoSpec to obtain the stated isomorphism on D_f. Nilpotent denominators give empty charts and zero localized modules, so no nonemptiness assumption is needed.
